name: convention-computed-key-literal
description: A computed property name whose expression is a string literal matches the key that literal spells, so a default export that sets the moved property under such a name moves the directory its entry globs name: the root file of the moved directory is a root and the one in the default directory is reported as a file nothing imports. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named react-router for the package @react-router/dev, holding the installed version in its range, whose entry globs name root.ts below an app directory that defaults to app and that the appDirectory property of react-router.config.ts moves.
